kind: fixed actual-prefix feasibility and cheap-fill diagnostic; not a strength test
selection: All40 pinned V6 boss games, every played state turn0..19; exact accepted own prefix analyzed whenever paint<3
prefix: Rules.expand on actual pre-turn board; Rules.applyPlacements for only recorded own accepted cells; canonical Rules.updateConnections; no opponent action, ink, income credit or turn advance
memory: Observe every actual pre-turn board and record actual accepted target; full prepare before actual prefix, mark each own cell and incremental prepare after it. No bot RNG or server timing reconstructed
fixedCheapFill: At most3 cells until remaining paint exhausted: legal, affordable, outside own actual target, town-region or instability0, orthogonally adjacent to an own track. Rank by count of adjacent own earning cells descending, then town-region first, terrain cost ascending, cell index ascending. Recompute eligibility and canonical earning paths after each placement. No candidate-specific income gain is used for ranking
income: Exact current canonical income before/after only own additions, via Rules.incomePerTurn. No imagined future actions, disruption or income horizon; a fact about this hypothetical board, not a win prediction
limitations: Recorded prefix fixes actual chosen cells/target, but does not reveal abort phase or why V6 stopped.
Ample feature candidates prove eligible alternatives exist; they do not reconstruct CG deadline/JIT/RNG behavior.
Cheap fill is one predeclared diagnostic rule, not a selected production policy; more paint and immediate income are not strength.
Town-region stability and adjacency restrictions are policy assumptions, not game rules.
Hypothetical own additions omit simultaneous opponent placements/disruption; no oracle opponent actions rank the filler.
Source markers are self-reported artifact attribution; checks do not attest remote executable bytes.
